summary.answer: Takes a container and index. Only if container[index] and its getText field are truthy, calls that method with the indexed element as self. Returns false for empty string or equality to the engine-localized hash_0 sentinel; otherwise returns textValue and true literally. A nil text returns false if the earlier localized-sentinel equality succeeds (including a nil sentinel); otherwise that nil reaches textValue and true and remains nil. After the prior false-return equality arms, a false text yields false and a truthy text yields true. If the element or method is absent the function falls through with no value. The outer container itself is not nil-guarded; there is no loop, mutation, callback or protected error handling.
